name: Malaga Turismo
verdict: The 'Málaga' mark of the Ayuntamiento de Málaga, the city council, placed through its municipal company Promálaga. Nothing found.
note: Proposed none 2026-09-28 (issue #340): the sponsor is the city council's own mark (club announcement, 2026-08-13; the tourism site visita.malaga.eu is the council's Área de Turismo). State ownership alone is not a tier; no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the Ayuntamiento de Málaga was found, so nothing found. Score and Change calls the vertical front logo 'Málaga Turismo'; the club calls it 'la marca Málaga en el lateral delantero'. It is one logo, so the kit lists it once.
